capabilities: Open .yxmd workflows in a dedicated read-only view
List .yxzp package entries and contained workflows
Show tools, connections, metadata, paths, and formulas
Report warnings for malformed XML and broken structure
Filter details and inspect source XML with line numbers
disambiguation: Not an Alteryx Designer substitute; it only renders read-only summaries and never runs, edits, converts, or saves workflows.
extras: No public release yet; install manually from GitHub release assets or via BRAT. Committed test fixtures are synthetic; the README warns not to commit real client workflows.
problem: Alteryx workflow and package files are opaque XML inside a vault, with no built-in way to inspect their tools, connections, paths, or structural problems.
summary: Read-only viewer that renders Alteryx .yxmd workflows and .yxzp packages as searchable summaries with tool, connection, and source XML views.
